market_facts.xometry_asset_light: Revenue +41% YoY to $229M in the quarter; growth guidance raised to 33-34%. https://3dprint.com/330078/3d-printing-financials-xometry-protolabs-and-lincoln-electric-post-strong-quarters/amp/
market_facts.protolabs_asset_heavy: Revenue +10.6% to $149.3M in the quarter; ~$533M annual revenue, $1.45B market cap; improving profitability, FY guidance 8-10% growth. Gross margin 44% vs Xometry 35.7%.
market_facts.protolabs_1999: CAD upload -> automated manufacturability analysis -> firm price in minutes -> toolpaths -> ~1M sq ft owned facilities; 1-200 parts in 1-3 days.
market_facts.mozaik_price: $125/month for CNC Complete: design through cut lists, nesting, machine-ready G-code.
market_facts.sendcutsend_ceiling: Instant-quote CNC routing of Baltic birch and MDF; largest instant-quote part 30 x 44 inches.
market_facts.cutwrights: UK, founded 2009 by two cabinetmakers; cut/edge/drill panels, 24/7 instant online quotes, 3-5 day lead, CNC saws to 3.8m at 0.1mm.
market_facts.steel_takeoff: Manual takeoff 4-8 hrs per mid-size structural package; automated tools cut to under 2 hrs; one estimator goes from 2 bids/week to 4-5.
market_facts.paperless_parts: Named by machinists as an existing quoting-acceleration tool; shops aiming to go from 5-day to 1-2 day quote turnaround.
